name: iter_paper_normal
description: PAPER FIGURE SET, setting 1 of 3 (NORMAL): the three mix policies the paper presents side by side - Constant (static), Exponential decay x0.1 (dynamic decrease), Adaptive severity (dynamic adaptive decrease) - all from the same starting mix 0.5, at the companion operating point (iters_initial 12, n_train 100, sigma 0.5, radius 0.25, no pool deficit), K=8, 15 seeds. Companion rows for iter_paper_lowpretrain and the scarcity setting covered by iter_money_policies.
